subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Demand Sensing
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Demand Sensing.

hook.text: Traditional forecasts update monthly. Demand sensing updates daily—or even hourly—using real-time data.

buildup.text: Demand sensing uses recent sales, orders, and external signals to adjust near-term forecasts rapidly.

discovery.text: It catches shifts that monthly models miss: weather events, social media trends, and competitor actions.

twist.text: Sensing helps the short term but adds noise to long-term plans. It works best within a 1–4 week window.

climax.text: Companies using demand sensing reduce short-term forecast error by 30–40% compared to static models.

punchline.text: Don't wait for the month-end report. Sense demand now.

quiz.question: What time horizon does demand sensing improve most?
